title: Reserve Accounting Basis: the Sum Freed From a Claim Reserve
content:
Money held back on a Keyturn Host Payout Account against a claim is freed once the claim it was held against has been answered on the account, so that the host is not left short of money the marketplace no longer has any exposure to.

## The quantities, in order

1. **The standing claim hold.** Every reserve taken against an open claim on the account, less every reserve already freed from it, rounded half to even to two decimal places.
2. **What the settlement money answers.** The excess of the correcting entries booked to the account over the standing claim hold, and never less than nothing.
3. **The part kept back against exposure that has not yet cooled.** What is answered taken at the standard residual share of 25 percent, rounded half to even to two decimal places.
4. **The routine reserve the account must go on carrying.** The routine reserves taken in the month up to that day, of which 25 percent, a quarter, is kept back out of the sum freed; that quarter is rounded half to even to two decimal places.
5. **The sum freed.** The standing claim hold that the settlement money has answered, less the part of it kept back against exposure that has not yet cooled, and less again the routine reserve the account must go on carrying.
6. **The release entry.** It books that sum, rounded half to even to two decimal places, and never less than nothing.

The two amounts taken off in step 5 are each worked out on their own base — the first on what the settlement money answers, the second on the routine reserve standing — and are then both taken off the sum answered; neither is worked out on the figure the other has already reduced.

## Worked through on hypothetical figures

Take a hypothetical account on which reserves of 6000.00 USD have been taken against an open claim and 1000.00 USD of that has already been freed, so the standing claim hold is 5000.00 USD; on which the correcting entries booked to it come to 7000.00 USD; and on which the routine reserves taken in the month up to that day come to 800.00 USD.

- What the settlement money answers is 7000.00 USD less 5000.00 USD, which is 2000.00 USD.
- The part kept back against exposure that has not yet cooled is 25 percent of 2000.00 USD, which is 500.00 USD.
- The routine reserve the account must go on carrying is a quarter of 800.00 USD, which is 200.00 USD.
- The sum freed is 2000.00 USD less 500.00 USD less 200.00 USD, which is 1300.00 USD, and 1300.00 USD is what the release entry books.

Where the correcting entries booked to the account come to less than the standing claim hold, what the settlement money answers falls to nothing, and the release entry books 0.00 USD rather than a negative figure.
